contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Accumulate abs(element - target) from left to right, starting at zero, and return the sum. Do not return the average.
contract.domain: The array is dense, has at most 32 finite numbers between -100 and 100, and must not be modified. Any returned array must be fresh with independent storage. Target is finite between -100 and 100.
contract.outputRole: sum of absolute deviations, zero for no observations
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
